itinerary.title: Citadel, river and royal tombs
itinerary.description:
08:00 — Hotel pickup, drive to the Imperial Citadel
08:30 — Imperial Citadel and the Forbidden Purple City
10:00 — Boat ride on the Perfume River to Thiên Mụ Pagoda
10:45 — Thiên Mụ Pagoda, Huế's oldest, built 1601
12:00 — Lunch: bún bò Huế at a riverside quán
13:30 — Khải Định royal tomb, European-Vietnamese fusion in concrete
15:00 — Tự Đức royal tomb, a lakeside retreat in the pines
16:30 — Cơm hến tasting stop at Vĩ Dạ before drop-off

tourData.meetingPoint: Arrival pickup at Nội Bài International Airport, Hà Nội (day 1)

itinerary.title: Arrival in Hà Nội
itinerary.description:
08:00 — Arrival transfer from Nội Bài airport to your Hà Nội hotel
14:00 — Old Quarter walking orientation, Hoàn Kiếm Lake
16:00 — Free time, check in and rest
19:00 — Welcome dinner, bún chả and local specialties

itinerary.title: Hà Nội heritage day
itinerary.description:
08:00 — Ba Đình Square, Hồ Chí Minh Mausoleum exterior
09:30 — Temple of Literature
11:30 — Lunch near Hoàn Kiếm Lake
14:00 — Đồng Xuân Market and Old Quarter craft streets
19:30 — Optional Water Puppet show

itinerary.title: Boarding for Hạ Long Bay
itinerary.description:
08:00 — Depart Hà Nội for Hạ Long (~3.5h)
11:30 — Board the junk, lunch as we cruise
14:00 — Sung Sốt Cave and kayaking at Luon Cave lagoon
19:00 — Dinner aboard, overnight at anchor

itinerary.title: Titop Island to Ninh Bình
itinerary.description:
06:30 — Sunrise tai chi, breakfast aboard
08:00 — Titop Island swim or viewpoint climb
09:30 — Disembark, drive to Ninh Bình (~2.5h)
14:30 — Bamboo boat through Tràng An's caves
18:30 — Check in, dinner, free evening in Ninh Bình

itinerary.title: Onward to imperial Huế
itinerary.description:
06:30 — Breakfast, drive back to Hà Nội (~2h)
09:30 — Domestic flight Hà Nội → Huế (~1.5h)
11:30 — Arrive Huế, transfer to hotel, lunch
14:00 — Perfume River boat to Thiên Mụ Pagoda
19:00 — Dinner, own arrangement on the riverside

itinerary.title: Huế's citadel and royal tombs
itinerary.description:
08:00 — Imperial Citadel and the Forbidden Purple City
10:30 — Khải Định royal tomb
12:30 — Lunch: bún bò Huế
14:30 — Đồng Khánh tomb or free time
19:00 — Royal-style dinner with traditional music (optional)

itinerary.title: Over Hải Vân pass to Hội An
itinerary.description:
07:30 — Check-out, drive over the Hải Vân pass coastal road
10:00 — Marble Mountains stop, Đà Nẵng
12:00 — Lunch in Đà Nẵng, view the Dragon Bridge
14:30 — Continue to Hội An, hotel check-in
19:00 — Lantern-lit Old Town evening walk

itinerary.title: A full day in Hội An
itinerary.description:
08:00 — Cooking class: shop the market, learn 3 local dishes
11:30 — Lunch: your own cooked dishes
14:00 — Basket boat ride through the coconut palm forest
16:30 — Free time for tailoring or the riverside
19:00 — Free evening, own arrangement

itinerary.title: South to Sài Gòn
itinerary.description:
07:30 — Breakfast, transfer to Đà Nẵng airport
09:30 — Domestic flight Đà Nẵng → Hồ Chí Minh City (~1.5h)
11:30 — Arrive Sài Gòn, transfer to hotel, lunch
14:30 — City tour: Notre-Dame Cathedral, Central Post Office
19:00 — Rooftop dinner over the Sài Gòn skyline

itinerary.title: Củ Chi and the city
itinerary.description:
08:00 — Drive to Củ Chi Tunnels (~1.5h)
09:30 — Tunnel network and wartime history tour
12:30 — Lunch, drive back to Sài Gòn
15:00 — Bến Thành Market, free afternoon
19:30 — Free evening, own arrangement

itinerary.title: Into the Mekong Delta
itinerary.description:
06:30 — Depart Sài Gòn for Cần Thơ (~3h)
10:00 — Boat ride to Cái Răng floating market
12:30 — Lunch on the riverbank
14:30 — Cycle through orchard villages on Cồn Sơn islet
18:00 — Overnight in Cần Thơ, free evening

itinerary.title: Cần Thơ to departure
itinerary.description:
06:00 — Early boat: Cái Răng at its dawn busiest (optional revisit)
08:00 — Breakfast, drive back to Sài Gòn (~3h)
11:30 — Farewell lunch
13:00 — Transfer to Tân Sơn Nhất airport for your onward flight
